integrity: Exact exhaustive point counts over degrees 1 through 9 and an analytic functional-equation proof; code supports but does not replace geometry or zeta theory.
scientific_limitations: Specific smooth projective genus-nine curve over F_2 only; no extension to whole Artin-Schreier family; no complete rational Jacobian group structure; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Exact zeta function and Jacobian isogeny profile of a genus-nine extremal curve
